subject: KV-cache & session token rotation — status + evidence for pen test finding
messages:
From: Mike Jenkins <mike.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: remediation status & evidence for pen test finding #4

Ben —

Thanks for taking this on. As part of Acme Logistics' SOC 2 evidence collection we need an update and artefacts for the penetration test finding labeled "4 - stale session tokens / KV cache exposure" (report attached). Specifically we need:

- Confirmation of the exact code changes deployed to address the KV cache exposure (diff or PR link)
- Evidence that session tokens were rotated or invalidated (rotation runbook, logs)
- Scan/verification output showing the vulnerability no longer reproduces (curl + response or automated scan report)
- ETA for full production rollout and any residual risk notes

We are on a tight timeline for our SOC 2 assessment; would you be able to provide the evidence by EOD Friday (2027-05-21)? If not, please propose a firm alternative.

Appreciate it — attaching the excerpt from the pen test report for reference (pt-findings-20270410.pdf).

— Mike
Mike Jenkins
Security Lead, Acme Logistics
security@acme.com


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mike Jenkins <mike.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation status & evidence for pen test finding #4

Mike —

Thanks for the clear checklist and the excerpt. We’ve triaged the finding and started remediation last week; here’s the current plan and immediate evidence we can share now:

- Code change: small patch that hardens KV cache read boundaries and prevents session-token keys from being persisted to disk. Patch file attached (kvcache_fix.patch). The PR is INF-987; merge to main completed in staging at 2027-05-19 22:40 UTC.
- Session rotation: automated rotation job created and run in staging; runbook attached (session_rotation_playbook.pdf).
- Verification: quick smoke test performed against staging; dev logs show no KV key leakage for the reproduced steps — we will run a full scan tonight and attach the report.
- Prod rollout ETA: rolling deploy scheduled for 2027-05-22 (can accelerate if required).

I’m copying Dev and Mina for technical and evidence confirmation. If you need a signed statement for SOC 2 evidence, Mina can provide the attestation once we have the final scan output.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0191

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation status & evidence for pen test finding #4

Ben / team —

Quick technical update from infra/runtime: the kvcache_fix.patch modifies cache key namespace handling and ensures session token keys are flagged ephemeral and purged from the disk-backed cache path. Summary of steps taken:

1) Patch applied to staging (branch: fix/kvcache-scope). PR INF-987 merged to main at 2027-05-19T22:40Z.
2) Staging deploy: 2027-05-19T23:15Z. Smoke tests run at 2027-05-20T03:00Z PST (attached minimal logs below). No leakage observed.
3) Session rotation: rotation job (rotate-sessions-v2) executed in staging at 2027-05-20T04:10Z — all long-lived tokens older than 30 days were invalidated and reissued with new TTL. We recorded rotation-start/rotation-complete events in auth.audit (log IDs provided).
4) Full dynamic re-scan scheduled: 2027-05-20T23:00Z by our scanning infra (Arachni-based); results will be uploaded to the evidence drive.

Attachments/artefacts I can provide immediately:
- kvcache_fix.patch (attached)
- minimal smoke logs (excerpt below)
- runbook: session_rotation_playbook.pdf (attached)

Smoke test excerpt:
---
[2027-05-20T03:01:12Z] INFO  runtime.cache: lookups=112 miss=1 write=0 flagged_ephemeral=0
[2027-05-20T03:01:15Z] INFO  auth.rotation: rotation-start id=rot-20270520-01 target_scope=staging
[2027-05-20T03:05:04Z] INFO  auth.rotation: rotation-complete id=rot-20270520-01 rotated=134 errors=0
---

Note: The production rollout is gated on a short verification window after the full dynamic scan completes (we expect clean results). If Acme requires the production rollout by 2027-05-21 EOD, we can prioritize and run the prod rotation earlier but will need a one-hour maintenance window (typical ephemeral auth disruption for < 5% of active sessions).

Let me know the preferred cutoff; otherwise we’ll proceed with the scheduled 2027-05-22 rollout.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
dev.patel@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Mike Jenkins <mike.jenkins@acme.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T18:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation status & evidence for pen test finding #4

Mike / Ben —

Thanks — I reviewed the staging artefacts Dev provided. For SOC 2 evidence we will produce the following deliverables once the dynamic scan completes and the prod rollout is confirmed:

- Signed remediation summary (PDF) describing the vulnerability, root cause, and mitigation steps.
- Audit log extracts showing rotation events (auth.audit: rot-20270520-01).
- PR/commit link (INF-987) and a byte-level diff (kvcache_fix.patch — provided).
- Dynamic scan report exported to PDF and the raw scanner output (will upload to the drive link below).

Drive (evidence): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BzAcmeEvidence/kvcache-rotation — I’ll upload the final artifacts there by 2027-05-21T14:00Z.

If you require an on-record attestation for your SOC 2 auditor, I can prepare a short signed statement once all artefacts are in the folder.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Security Manager, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

From: Mike Jenkins <mike.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: 2027-05-21T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation status & evidence for pen test finding #4

Thanks for the rapid turnaround and clear list. Two quick notes:

- The Acme SOC 2 auditor is flexible but asked for the final artefacts before 2027-05-24 to include in the audit packet. Your target of 2027-05-21T14:00Z for the uploads works fine.
- We do prefer a brief signed attestation from your security manager that the fix was deployed and validated in prod; the auditor flags signed statements higher in priority.

If you upload the artefacts and the attestation to the drive link you quoted, we’ll mark this finding as resolved from our side and close the ticket.

Appreciate the collaboration — we’ll be in touch if anything else is needed.

— Mike
